summary: In Step 1, I tapped the 'Log In' button marked in red on the Welcome screen; the display transitioned to the 'Welcome back!' login page. This new screen features input fields for 'Email address' and 'Password', a 'Log in' button, a 'Forgot password?' link, a 'Continue with Google' button, and a 'Sign up' link at the bottom. The top of the screen displays the text 'Find Events. Make Memories.' along with three event-related images, and a 'Skip' button is visible in the top right corner.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Email address' input field and typed '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'; the field now displays 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com', and the on-screen keyboard has appeared at the bottom of the display. The 'Password' field, 'Forgot password?' link, 'Log in' button, 'Continue with Google' button, and 'Sign up' link remain visible on the screen above the keyboard. The overall layout of the 'Welcome back!' page is otherwise unchanged, with the 'evia' logo and descriptive text still present at the top.

In Step 3, I tapped the 'Password' input field marked in red and typed '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. The field, which was previously empty, now displays a series of masked characters ending in '9'. The rest of the 'Welcome back!' screen remains unchanged, showing the email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' in the field above, the 'Forgot password?' link, the 'Log in' button, and the 'Continue with Google' option, with the system keyboard still visible at the bottom of the screen.

In Step 4, I tapped the 'Done' button on the keyboard marked in red; the keyboard immediately disappeared from the screen, revealing the full 'Welcome back!' login interface. The email field remains populated with 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' and the password field shows masked characters. Following the tap, the 'Log in' button transitioned from a solid blue color to a greyed-out, inactive state, and a circular loading spinner icon appeared directly to the left of the 'Log in' text.

In Step 5, I waited for 5000ms; the screen transitioned from the login interface to the main Discover dashboard. The new screen displays the greeting "Hey EVIA E2E!", a balance of "200 coins", and a search bar. Below, a featured event titled "[DEMO] Flutter và Firebase từ cơ bản" is visible, along with a bottom navigation bar containing "Discover", "Events", "Rewards", and "Profile" tabs, with the "Discover" tab currently highlighted and active.

In Step 6, I tapped the 'Events' tab located in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'My Events' page, which displays the header 'My Events' and the sub-header 'Manage your registrations and passes'. The page shows 'Upcoming 0' and 'Past 0' tabs, a calendar view for 'Nov 2 - Nov 8, 2026', and a central message stating 'No events on this date' with a 'Show all events' button below it, while the 'Events' icon in the bottom navigation bar is now highlighted.

In Step 7, I tapped the 'Rewards' tab located in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Rewards' view, which displays 'Available Coins' of 200, a 'View coin history' link, and an 'In Deposits' section showing 0 coins. The interface now features 'Earn Coins' and 'Redeem Rewards' tabs, a 'Daily Check-in' section indicating a '1-day streak', and a blue 'Check In +5 coins' button, while the 'Rewards' icon in the bottom navigation bar is now highlighted with a blue dot indicating it is the active selection.

In Step 8, I tapped the 'Profile' tab icon located in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Profile' view, which displays the user name 'EVIA E2E', ID 'SE990001', and email '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. Below the 'Edit Profile' button, the screen lists 'YOUR ACTIVITY' categories including 'Saved Events', 'Following', and 'Notifications', followed by 'PREFERENCES & SUPPORT' options for 'My Interests' and 'App Settings'. The 'Profile' icon in the bottom navigation bar is now highlighted as the active selection, confirming the transition from the previous 'Rewards' screen.
